program.name: Pyramid HIIT
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: Rep ladders that climb and climb, with a Tabata or an AMRAP to finish.
program.about: Rep ladders that climb: one rep of each move, then two, then three, for as long as the clock allows. One day pairs the ladder with a Tabata, the other with an AMRAP. Abs close every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations. Satisfying if you like seeing a number go up.
